Question: assalamu-alaikum By the grace of Allah I am blessed with a son on 12th Novemeber-2009 at 5.37PM. Kindly suggest some names for my son. one of my relative recomended "Muhammad Faaz" is it coorect name. Answer ID: 18843 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 75/75=M=1431) Instead of Muhammad Faaz, you should name him ?Muhammad Fayyaz? or ?Muhammad Faaiz? ( محمد فياض, محمد فائز ), or any of these names: Muhammad Rashid, Sayeed, Hasan, Abdullah, Abdur Rahman, Ahmad etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
